# gi.ags_schemas.check_ags_proj_group { #bedrock_ge.gi.ags_schemas.check_ags_proj_group }

```python
gi.ags_schemas.check_ags_proj_group(ags_proj)
```

Checks if the AGS 3 or AGS 4 PROJ group is correct.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name     | Type         | Description                        | Default    |
|----------|--------------|------------------------------------|------------|
| ags_proj | pd.DataFrame | The DataFrame with the PROJ group. | _required_ |

## Raises {.doc-section .doc-section-raises}

| Name   | Type       | Description                                  |
|--------|------------|----------------------------------------------|
|        | ValueError | If AGS 3 of AGS 4 PROJ group is not correct. |

## Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

| Name   | Type   | Description                                               |
|--------|--------|-----------------------------------------------------------|
|        | bool   | Returns True if the AGS 3 or AGS 4 PROJ group is correct. |
